name: Yedora Gravekeeper
occupation: Professor of Death, Witherbloom College, Strixhaven University
personality: Calm and enigmatic, Yedora maintains a composed demeanor with a hint of melancholy. She exudes a quiet authority and seems deeply connected to the cycles of life and death.
bonds: Loyal to the Witherbloom College and the natural balance of life and death, but conflicted due to her secret allegiance.
secrets: She is secretly a member of the Oryx blood cult and subtly misleads the players investigating it, guiding them away from the cult’s true activities.
involvedPlots: The Oryx blood cult conspiracy at Strixhaven University

name: Philus Draxen
occupation: Professor of Rhetoric and Debate, Silverquill College, Strixhaven University
personality: Witty, charismatic, and sharp-tongued, Philus thrives in intellectual sparring and enjoys mentoring students to refine their argumentation skills. Beneath his confident exterior lies a deeply loyal and thoughtful partner.
bonds: Deeply devoted to Silverquill College and its values, he shares a romantic relationship with Yedora Gravekeeper, balancing logic and emotion between them.
secrets: Though outwardly skeptical of cult activities, he is plagued by doubts about his own judgment, fearing his romance with Yedora might blind him to her true allegiances.
involvedPlots: The Oryx blood cult conspiracy at Strixhaven University
